full_name: Jennifer L. Hochschild | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Jennifer L. Hochschild is the Henry Lebarre Jayne Professor of Government at Harvard University, with a joint appointment in Afro-American studies and lectureships at the Kennedy School of Government and the Graduate School of Education.
